text: dsh-startup-blade 是适用于 DSH Web 客户端的拔刀风格启动动画插件。它通过客户端画布动画和宿主只读路由，在启动时展示划开黑幕、刀光与火星，随后淡出到当前界面；也可播放本地视频、分层图像或定格图片。可调整播放速度、停留时长和刀光颜色，并支持点击或按键跳过。无需 API 密钥，素材可放在本机 DSH 数据目录。

dsh-startup-blade adds a blade-draw startup animation to the DSH Web client. It uses a browser canvas and host routes to reveal the interface, or play local video, layered art, or a freeze frame. Adjust speed, hold time, and color; click or press a key to skip. No API key is needed.

DSH 启动页能不能用自己的短视频做开场，然后停在最后一帧？
Add a custom startup splash animation to the DSH web interface.
dsh-startup-blade 的功能「启动拔刀动画」：DSH Web 界面就绪后播放黑幕划开、刀光和火星动画，再淡出显示当前界面；用户可点击或按任意键跳过。动画每个应用会话最多播放一次。
dsh-startup-blade 的功能「自定义素材开场」：可从本地素材目录读取短视频、分层图像或定格图片作为启动动画，并在配置为自动模式时按可用素材选择呈现方式；媒体无法播放时回退到基础动画。
dsh-startup-blade 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 6 天；提交数 3；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-startup-blade README · dsh-startup-blade · blade-draw splash for DeepSeek Harness：> A blade is unsheathed, cuts the black screen open, and the UI emerges from the slash —
> freezing on the frame of the wallpaper you are looking at.

A decoration-only plugin: roughly **2.6 s** of startup animation, once per app launch, then it
removes itself. Nothing stays mounted, no idle CPU, no input blocked.
section: dsh-startup-blade · blade-draw splash for DeepSeek Harness

text:
dsh-startup-blade README · Timeline：| Time | Frame |
| --- | --- |
| 0.00–0.20s | Black drops in, a cold glint at the scabbard |
| 0.18–0.78s | **Draw**: the blade sweeps bottom-right → top-left, the screen shakes slightly, and the black is genuinely *cut* — the real UI shows through the wound |
| 0.78–1.10s | White flash plus a thin lingering cut line |
| 1.10–2.40s | The black dissolves; sparks fall |
| 2.40s+ | **Freeze**: rests on the live UI (wallpaper already rendered), or on your own frozen frame for `hold` ms |

dsh-startup-blade README · Timeline：It will not replay on a page refresh in the same app session, and a click / any key skips
straight to the end.

dsh-startup-blade README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-startup-blade
```

Restart DeepSeek Harness afterwards (client plugins are mounted at startup; a page refresh is
not enough).

dsh-startup-blade README · Freeze on your own frame：Default is **reveal mode**: the slash exposes the live UI, so the ending *is* your current frame
and needs no image.

dsh-startup-blade README · The character actually moving: clip mode：The streak version is decoration. To see **the character in your wallpaper** draw the blade, the
only faithful route is a recording — those characters are usually rigged Wallpaper Engine puppet
scenes whose motion lives in `.mdl` bones, with no exportable video asset.
section: The character actually moving: clip mode

text:
dsh-startup-blade README · The character actually moving: clip mode：Drop a 3–5 s clip at `%DSH_HOME%\startup-blade\splash.mp4` (or `splash.webm`) and the plugin
switches to **clip mode**: play through → hold on the last frame for `hold` ms → fade to the UI.
Click/key skips; a decode failure falls back to the streak version instead of a black screen.
1920×1080, H.264, no audio track, under 5 s, no UI overlay in frame.
section: The character actually moving: clip mode

text:
dsh-startup-blade README · The character actually moving: clip mode：For a hard freeze on a still: drop a screenshot at
`%DSH_HOME%\startup-blade\frame.png` (also `frame.jpg`, `frame.jpeg`, `frame.webp`). The plugin
switches to freeze mode automatically. `assets/frame-sample.jpg` is a placeholder you can copy
there to try it.

The plugin ships **no wallpaper artwork**; your frame stays on your machine.
section: The character actually moving: clip mode

dsh-startup-blade README · Config：`%DSH_HOME%\startup-blade\config.json` overrides the row config in `cordis.patch.yml`.

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | master switch |
| `speed` | `1` | playback multiplier, `0.5`–`2` |
| `hold` | `620` | freeze hold (ms) |
| `accent` | `#9fe8ff` | blade colour |
| `mode` | `auto` | `auto` / `reveal` / `freeze` |

Runtime escape hatches: `?nosplash` in the URL, or
`localStorage.setItem('dsh-startup-blade:off','1')`.

dsh-startup-blade README · Compatibility：DSH desktop / web profile, standard `dsh.bundle.patch` + `dsh.client`, no runtime dependencies,
no build step. Honours `prefers-reduced-motion`.
